verify_by: Copy tests/solo-finder-color-run.go to gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/markdown/mathml/zz_color_test.go and run go test -count=1 -run TestZZColorRun -v at 9a2b61f5f and with tokenize.go at 6c49f5420 (the only non-test file the diff changes)
tldr: A run of K bare \color commands converts in K^2 time, at head and at the base alike, since each failed switch scans to its cell end and Ungets
details: commands.go:325 walks b.Expr from b.idx to the cell end for every style switch; a \color with no {group} fails GetNextExpr and calls b.Unget() at commands.go:348, so the next \color walks the same tokens again. Time grows about 3.6-4x per doubling on both trees. Predates the diff and sits outside the class it sweeps: the cost is the cell-end scan of every token, not a walk of a blank run. gnoweb caps one expression at MaxMathInputLen = 8 << 10 (ext_math.go:21), about 1365 copies, so a page reader loses nothing measurable; the finder's 1 MiB page probe read 56 ms at head, 54 ms at base. The PR body's `a math expression costs its length` overstates for this shape, which is the description's to correct and never the draft's. The fix, stopping the scan or the retry after a failed switch, is a design decision for the author, out of this PR's scope.
evidence: head: `color x8192 (49154 bytes): 62ms`, `color x16384 (98306 bytes): 221ms`, `color x32768 (196610 bytes): 905ms`; base tokenize.go: `60ms`, `224ms`, `850ms`; `git diff --stat 6c49f5420 -- mathml/ ':!*_test.go'` empty with base tokenize.go in place
